notes.title: How to play?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/305ba395eca7e8a5e3ccff79332d066e984149b2.png[/img]

If you know which block you're going to drag,
You're already ready!

If you don't know...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/0a62a69578d210e006d0b35de229d2961cac8b6a.png[/img]
Drag the block with the mouse

and

Don't hesitate to look at the hint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/1a56a31508db0db3c09af0c3fc123339582bdf9b.png[/img]

also...

The best record will be registered on the leaderboard
Don't forget you're the best!

notes.title: How to get a hints
notes.content:
It's a puzzle game, so there will be a lack of hints.

How to get a hints...

[b]1. Emergency Mode[/b]

[b]Press the 'Spacebar' key on the keyboard or the 'X' button on the controller[/b]

Let's start the game
Hints will be added as much as lamb is saved in emergency mode

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/4ba878a0e0386de908d88362a255b35b755a7324.png[/img]


[b]2. Click on photo obtained[/b]

After moving from "Lobby" to "Photo"

[b]Click on a specific point in the photo you obtained[/b]

You will get 15 hints for each photo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/5a33022d54552740fa9a117000cf02fc9051b140.png[/img]

[b]Maximum addition of hints is 99.[/b]

notes.title: Emergency mode?
notes.content:
If someone knocks on your room during gameplay...

[b]Press the 'Spacebar' key on the keyboard or the 'X' button on the controller[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/a138adbe95c1580c79548326ac0ec5bae44b9da6.png[/img]

then...

'Saving the Lambs!' The cute game begins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42811500/4ba878a0e0386de908d88362a255b35b755a7324.png[/img]

Protect yourself from your mother or sister

But...

The game is easy and cute, so women can like it... 

Be careful
